nodes.label: 5-HT2A receptor
nodes.summary: Human serotonin receptor HTR2A. Transducer coupling depends on the ligand, assay, and cell system.

nodes.label: Gαq-GTP
nodes.summary: Active Gαq. PLCβ and p63RhoGEF represent separate effector branches.

nodes.label: Gαi activation
nodes.summary: Additional ligand- and assay-dependent coupling entry point shown for 5-HT2A.

nodes.label: PLCβ activity
nodes.summary: Activated PLCβ cleaves membrane PIP₂. The direct effector experiment here used PLCβ3.

nodes.label: Membrane PIP₂
nodes.summary: PtdIns(4,5)P₂ available to enzymes and lipid-dependent membrane effectors.

nodes.label: IP₃
nodes.summary: Soluble inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate produced when phosphoinositide-specific PLC cleaves PIP₂.

nodes.label: IP₃ receptor opening
nodes.summary: IP₃-sensitive intracellular Ca²⁺ channel. Ca²⁺ and ATP can shape gating.

nodes.label: Cytosolic Ca²⁺
nodes.summary: Free Ca²⁺ rises during store release or influx. Compartment-targeted reporters can localize changes.

nodes.label: DAG
nodes.summary: Membrane diacylglycerol generated by PIP₂ hydrolysis or alternative lipid pathways.

nodes.label: PKC activity
nodes.summary: DAG-sensitive PKCs phosphorylate substrates. Conventional and novel isoforms differ in calcium dependence.

nodes.label: Kv7.2/7.3 M current
nodes.summary: PIP₂-supported KCNQ2/3 current can regulate neuronal excitability.

nodes.label: p63RhoGEF / ARHGEF25
nodes.summary: Gαq-regulated guanine nucleotide exchange factor for RhoA.

nodes.label: RhoA-GTP
nodes.summary: GTP-loaded RhoA engages effectors that control actin and contractility.

nodes.label: ROCK activity
nodes.summary: Rho-associated kinase can respond to active RhoA and act on cytoskeletal substrates.

nodes.label: Full-length TrkB receptor
nodes.summary: BDNF-responsive kinase-active NTRK2 receptor. Docking-site numbering follows the cited rodent studies.

nodes.label: TrkB pY816 docking site
nodes.summary: Phosphorylated C-terminal site supporting PLCγ signaling.

nodes.label: PLCγ1 activity
nodes.summary: PLCγ1 couples phosphorylated RTKs to phosphoinositide hydrolysis. Recruitment and catalytic activity can be measured separately.

nodes.label: TrkB pY515 docking site
nodes.summary: Juxtamembrane phosphotyrosine site that supports Shc and FRS2 signaling.

nodes.label: Shc/FRS2 signaling module
nodes.summary: Adaptor signaling downstream of the TrkB Y515 site. This node groups two adaptor families, which docking-site mutation alone cannot separate.

nodes.label: ERK1/2 activity
nodes.summary: Kinase activity may be measured separately from ERK phosphorylation or subcellular localization.

nodes.label: CREB phosphorylation
nodes.summary: Activity-associated CREB phosphorylation can be downstream of TrkB signaling and multiple kinase routes.

assays.label: TRUPATH Gαq heterotrimer
assays.measures: Agonist-dependent rearrangement of the tagged Gαqβγ complex.
assays.validation: Live heterologous cells, including 5-HT2A transducer profiling.
assays.controls: Use vehicle, receptor-negative cells, a reference agonist and verified sensor stoichiometry.
assays.limit: The BRET shift reflects distance and orientation and does not directly quantify Gαq-GTP.

evidence.locator: Figs. 1–2, sensor design and transducer profiling
evidence.context: Live cells expressing GPCRs and donor/acceptor-tagged heterotrimer subunits
evidence.perturbation: Receptor agonist titrations and transducer-specific sensor configurations
evidence.finding: Tagged heterotrimer conformational changes generated rapid transducer-resolved assay signals.

evidence.locator: Fig. 5 and Supplementary Fig. 13
evidence.context: Heterologous 5-HT2A and tagged G protein assay
evidence.finding: Ligands produced distinct time- and concentration-dependent Gαq assay responses.

assays.label: TRUPATH Gi/o heterotrimer
assays.measures: Agonist-dependent rearrangement of a tagged Gi/o heterotrimer.
assays.validation: Live heterologous cells, using subtype-specific sensor constructs.
assays.controls: Use agonist and vehicle references, receptor-negative wells and matched subtype expression.
assays.limit: Sensor response is subtype- and expression-dependent and does not establish coupling in native tissue.

evidence.locator: Figs. 1–2, sensor design and transducer profiling
evidence.context: Live cells expressing GPCRs and donor/acceptor-tagged heterotrimer subunits
evidence.perturbation: Receptor agonist titrations and transducer-specific sensor configurations
evidence.finding: Tagged heterotrimer conformational changes generated rapid transducer-resolved assay signals.

assays.label: Reconstituted PLCβ3 lipase activity

assays.controls: Compare vehicle, basal activity and effector-interface mutations.
assays.limit: Cellular inositol phosphate accumulation can include other PLC isoforms.

evidence.locator: Fig. 2D–E and supplementary Fig. S5

evidence.readout: Inositol phosphate accumulation, binding and lipase activity
evidence.finding: Interface mutants weakened the Gq response with retained basal lipase activity in purified preparations.

assays.label: Lyn-PlcR PIP₂ reporter
assays.measures: Conformation of a membrane-localized PH-domain probe responsive to available PIP₂.
assays.validation: Live COS-7 cells following acetylcholine stimulation.

evidence.locator: Fig. 1
evidence.context: COS-7 cells expressing membrane-localized Lyn-PlcR
evidence.finding: The reporter detected dynamic membrane phosphoinositide changes.

assays.label: IRIS-1 IP₃ indicator
assays.measures: Ligand-binding-dependent conformational response to cytosolic IP₃.
assays.validation: Live HeLa cells during histamine-induced calcium oscillations.
assays.controls: Calibrate IP₃ response and verify the binding-dependent signal with an appropriate control probe.
assays.limit: Expression, buffering, and affinity can affect quantitative recovery of local IP₃.

evidence.locator: Figs. 1–4
evidence.context: Cytosolic FRET imaging in HeLa cells
evidence.readout: IRIS-1 ratio and co-measured cytosolic Ca²⁺
evidence.finding: Histamine increased cytosolic IP₃ before the first calcium rise in the tested cells.

assays.label: Nuclear-envelope single-channel recording
assays.measures: Single-channel opening and closing events in an IP₃-sensitive membrane preparation.
assays.validation: Isolated Xenopus oocyte nuclei and native outer nuclear membrane.
assays.controls: Compare IP₃ concentrations and control ionic conditions at the cytosolic face.
assays.limit: Isolated-membrane behavior cannot by itself identify the channel source of a cytosolic transient in intact cells.

evidence.locator: Results, single-channel IP₃ sensitivity and kinetics
evidence.context: Isolated Xenopus oocyte nuclei, outer nuclear membrane
evidence.finding: IP₃-sensitive channels opened in the native nuclear envelope preparation.

assays.label: jGCaMP8 calcium indicator
assays.measures: Ca²⁺-dependent fluorescence of a genetically encoded single fluorescent protein reporter.
assays.validation: Neurons in culture and in vivo in the primary validation.
assays.controls: Use unstimulated baseline, a positive calcium or depolarization control, and targeted perturbations for source attribution.
assays.limit: Fluorescence depends on indicator expression and kinetics. A cytosolic trace does not identify the Ca²⁺ source.

evidence.locator: Figs. 1 and 3
evidence.context: Engineered neurons and mouse visual cortex
evidence.finding: jGCaMP8 variants tracked rapid changes with distinct kinetic properties.

assays.label: GCaMP6f in TrkB-expressing axons
assays.measures: Local calcium-event frequency and fluorescence amplitude.
assays.validation: Cortical axons in an in vitro corticostriatal microfluidic culture.
assays.controls: Compare wild-type TrkB with Y816F and analyze an unstimulated baseline.
assays.limit: Changes in event frequency and amplitude can have different interpretations and neither identifies a channel without a channel perturbation.

evidence.locator: Fig. 7A–C
evidence.context: Corticostriatal microfluidic cultures, cortical axons
evidence.perturbation: BDNF stimulation of wild-type TrkB versus Y816F
evidence.finding: BDNF increased axonal calcium events in wild-type but not Y816F-expressing axons.

assays.label: Digda-derived DAG reporter

assays.label: TrkB–PLCγ1 co-immunoprecipitation and PLCγ1 pY783
